summary: Milestone: the phone-only pipeline is PROVEN end to end on the owner's free Colab T4 — 4-bit UMT5 fix worked (host RAM 8.1-9.1 GB free), one clip rendered in 49 s (33 frames, 30 steps), upscale fell back to ffmpeg lanczos because basicsr would not build, ZIP landed in Drive 05 · Projects/m-test-01/. viper-1.8 hardens that install (--no-build-isolation + functional_tensor patch) and replaces guessed timings with measured ones. Only remaining gap: the sandbox cannot reach Google hosts, so mix/verify/assemble need the 0.2 MB ZIP attached in chat.
next_action: Owner attaches m-test-01_outputs.zip; then mobile_ops ingest mob-test-01 --zip <path> -> check -> finish -> deliver with the Drive id.
